result.description:
Application & Technical Support Technician (Level 1)    
 
 
 Provide first line support across systems and infrastructure 
 
 
 Exposure to Active Directory, RDS, and Manhattan WMS 
 
 
 6 month full time contract in Altona North location - 5 days on-site  
 
 $60,000 + Superannuation pa. (prorated over 6 months)  
 
 
   Accelerate Your IT Career in Enterprise Supply Chain Operations  
 Step into an active operational environment supporting key systems, network infrastructure, and enterprise applications. This 6 month full time contract position sits within a premier national distribution enterprise based in Altona North. Reporting to the Technical Services Manager, you will serve as the first point of contact for technical resolution across corporate offices, retail channels, and high volume distribution facilities. 
  The Role  You will own the day to day ticket lifecycle through Freshdesk, triaging and resolving Level 1 support requests within defined service level agreements. This position delivers broad technical exposure, ranging from endpoint hardware configuration to user session management and enterprise application troubleshooting. 
 Key responsibilities include: 
 
 
 Managing Active Directory user accounts, access permissions, and group policies. 
 
 
 Resolving Remote Desktop Services (RDS) user session disconnects and connectivity issues. 
 
 
 Troubleshooting local network connectivity (LAN/Wi-Fi) and maintaining network printer infrastructure. 
 
 
 Delivering end user PC support, including device setup, imaging, and software installation. 
 
 
 Supporting core enterprise tools, including Sage 300/Accpac ERP and Manhattan Scale Warehouse Management System (WMS). 
 
 
 Building internal knowledge base documentation by recording recurring issues and standard resolutions. 
 
 
   The Tech Stack & Environment  
 
 
  Identity & Access:  Active Directory 
 
 
  Remote Access:  Remote Desktop Services (RDS) 
 
 
  Ticketing & Service Desk:  Freshdesk 
 
 
  Enterprise Applications:  Sage 300 / Accpac, Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE/BC 
 
 
  Supply Chain Tech:  Manhattan Scale WMS, thermal network printers, barcode endpoints 
 
 
  Database & Diagnostic Tools:  Microsoft SQL (basic query execution) 
 
 
   What You'll Bring  
 
 
 Demonstrated track record in a Level 1 application or technical helpdesk role. 
 
 
 Practical experience administering Active Directory user accounts and permissions. 
 
 
 Familiarity supporting Remote Desktop Services (RDS) environments. 
 
 
 Exposure to ERP platforms (Sage 300/Accpac) or Warehouse Management Systems (Manhattan Scale) highly regarded. 
 
 
 Strong endpoint troubleshooting skills across PC hardware, software, and local network setups. 
 
 
 Calm, customer focused communication style with structured ticket logging discipline. 
 
 
 Full working rights in Australia for the duration of the 6 month term. 
 
 
   Apply Now  
 Submit your CV directly to launch your application for immediate consideration. 
 
   

 At Randstad, we are passionate about providing equal employment opportunities and embracing diversity to the benefit of all. We actively encourage applications from any background. 
   
    Please  click here  to apply.

?? A-Grade Project Manager Wanted – Shape the Future with Bowhill Engineering ??
Location: Bowhill, Mid Murray SA | Salary: $100k –$140k + Incentives


Ready to lead landmark infrastructure projects and be part of something truly transformational?


At Bowhill Engineering, we’re not just building bridges, tunnels and steel structures – we’re building a bold future for South Australia. With our brand new B5 facility and $6 million investment in robotics and machining for the Torrens to Darlington Tunnel project, we’re looking for an A-Grade Project Manager to help us triple our impact over the next five years.


Why this role is different:
? Be hands-on with cutting-edge technology and nationally significant infrastructure
? Escape corporate red tape – make real decisions, fast
? Enjoy the flexibility, support and values of a progressive regional business
? Lead high-performing teams with strong project admin support
? Country lifestyle, close-knit team, big-city project pipeline


You’ll thrive if you:
?? Are a confident and experienced Project Manager (5+ years in construction, steel or similar)
?? Love fast-paced, meaningful work and seeing tangible project outcomes
?? Are driven by team success and building genuine client relationships
?? Want to grow personally and professionally in a team that cares


But this might not be for you if:
? You prefer predictability over progress
? You shy away from accountability and outcome-driven work
? You’re only here for the money – we reward commitment and shared wins


More reasons to join Team Boweng:
?? Relocation, DIDO & Accommodation Support
?? Learning Culture & Personal Growth Plans
?? Performance-Based Reviews + Wage Boost Incentives
?? Values-Driven Family Business
?? Regular Celebrations of Team Success


Apply today and become part of a company that’s building more than just structures – we’re building a great place to work.
?? Contact: Samantha Krollig, HR Manager 08 8570 4208
?? Learn more and apply via our Bowhill Engineering website.


Together we thrive.
